item.label: Which documents do I need?
What should my medical records explain?
What else can support my application?
My impairment has been there since childhood
My impairment developed after illness or an accident
Proceed to application

custom.eventDescription:
Start with medical records from the place where your impairment is being treated, or was most recently assessed or treated. These may be:

  • Hospital or outpatient-clinic records from sundhed.dk.
  • Records from your specialist or private hospital.
  • Relevant parts of your GP's record, especially if your GP is the only doctor who has treated you.

Name each impairment you want considered and attach documentation about each. You do not need to pay for new documentation just to apply. The next tips depend on whether treatment has finished.
custom.guide: SU-Handicap-report.md — Minimum documentation; www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_om-dokumentation.md — Minimumskrav til dokumentation; Sådan skaffer du din dokumentation; www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_spoergsmaal-og-svar-om-handicaptillaeg.md — Hvilken dokumentation skal jeg vedlægge?

item.label: Yes, it has finished
No, treatment is ongoing
It varies, or I'm not sure

custom.eventDescription:
Include the discharge summary or final treatment note, if one was issued, alongside the records of your treatment.

If your GP now follows your condition, include relevant GP records too. Older hospital records can still be useful; newer evidence helps explain how the impairment affects you now.

Include your latest records and any available treatment plan. You may not have a discharge summary yet, and that is expected while treatment is continuing.

The records should help describe your current symptoms, treatment and daily functioning. Give the agency the contact details of your current treatment provider in the application.
custom.guide: www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_om-dokumentation.md — Hvad skal den lægefaglige dokumentation indeholde?; www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_spoergsmaal-og-svar-om-handicaptillaeg.md — Hvad sker der, hvis den vedlagte dokumentation ikke er nok?

custom.eventDescription:
For each impairment you want considered, use records from its most recent assessment or treatment. Include a final note for a completed course and current records for ongoing treatment.

If your latest records are more than three years old, attach them anyway. Add newer relevant documentation if you have it; age alone is not a reason to leave the records out.
custom.guide: www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_om-dokumentation.md — Minimumskrav til dokumentation; Eksempler på konkret dokumentation

item.label: Yes, show me the steps
No thanks, show the other topics

custom.eventDescription:
For hospital records:

  • Log in to sundhed.dk with MitID and open Sundhedsjournalen.
  • Choose Journal fra sygehus and find the relevant treatment course.
  • Use Udskriv alle notater, then Udskriv and Gem som PDF.

For GP, specialist or private-hospital records, ask the provider for a copy of the relevant records — you can request access to your record. Gather the documentation in a few clearly named PDF files for the application.
custom.guide: www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_om-dokumentation.md — Sådan henter du din journal fra sundhed.dk; www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_saadan-soeger-du-handicaptillaeg.md — Du skal samle din dokumentation i få filer

custom.eventDescription:
A diagnosis is only part of the picture. Your medical documentation should describe:

  • Your diagnosis, if one has been made, and your illness and treatment history.
  • How the impairment affects your everyday functioning now.
  • Your current treatment and any planned treatment.
  • How it affects your ability to work, if this can be described.

Send relevant existing records that give this picture. Records can meet the minimum requirements while still leaving the agency needing more information before it can decide your case. A personal statement can add your perspective, but does not replace the medical evidence.
custom.guide: SU-Handicap-report.md — Documentation and the application workflow; www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_om-dokumentation.md — Hvad skal den lægefaglige dokumentation indeholde?; Anden dokumentation; Personlig redegørelse

item.label: Yes, that would help
No thanks, show the other topics

custom.eventDescription:
Examples include:

  • A brief letter that only confirms a diagnosis.
  • A medication list or a list of treatment locations.
  • A jobcentre record or an SPS/other decision without medical information.
  • A referral or a general psychologist statement without supporting medical documentation.

These may still be useful supplements. A detailed specialist-psychologist diagnostic assessment is a distinct case described in the documentation guidance; it should not be confused with a brief psychologist statement. For applications from 1 July 2025, missing minimum documentation can lead to refusal to process the application. This is different from a decision that you do not qualify.
custom.guide: www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_om-dokumentation.md — Vi kan afvise din ansøgning, hvis du kun vedlægger; Psykiske funktionsnedsættelser; www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_spoergsmaal-og-svar-om-handicaptillaeg.md — Hvad sker der, hvis den vedlagte dokumentation ikke er nok?

custom.eventDescription:
For applications from 1 July 2025, if the minimum requirements were met, you can send further relevant evidence until the agency decides your case, through Digital Post or Kig i egen sag.

If the minimum was not met and the application is refused processing, the FAQ directs you to apply again with the required records; sending more later does not repair that application. Applications made before 1 July 2025 follow the earlier procedure, under which the agency may obtain additional evidence.
custom.guide: www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_spoergsmaal-og-svar-om-handicaptillaeg.md — Kan jeg sende mere dokumentation, hvis den vedlagte dokumentation ikke er nok?; SU-Handicap-report.md — Minimum documentation; dismissal vs denial

custom.eventDescription:
You may already have useful material beyond the minimum medical records: a specialist report from an insurance case, a neuropsychological assessment, a medical certificate used for sick leave, or records of a jobcentre work trial.

Descriptions from a mentor, special school or support service can also help explain your functioning. Attach relevant material you already have; you do not need to purchase new documentation for this.

Two especially useful additions are your own account of everyday life and a description of any current or previous work.
custom.guide: SU-Handicap-report.md — Documentation; www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_om-dokumentation.md — Anden dokumentation; Dokumentation for erhvervsevne; Personlig redegørelse

item.label: Writing my personal statement
Describing my work history
Both
Show the other topics

custom.eventDescription:
Describe how your impairment affects an ordinary day and your ability to have a student job. Explain the challenges you experience and any aids, practical support or adjustments you use.

Include your current or previous work experience. If your impairment began after a period of full-time work, a short timeline can help make that clear.

Your statement adds context to the medical records. It does not replace them.

If you have worked before or during your studies, describe:

  • Your duties and working hours.
  • Any adjustments or special support you needed.
  • Sick leave linked to your impairment and when the work took place.

You can add existing descriptions from an employer, support person or jobcentre. If you work while the application is being processed, send a description of that work too. The agency assesses the circumstances individually; this conversation does not turn your work history into an automatic eligibility result.
custom.guide: www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_om-dokumentation.md — Dokumentation for erhvervsevne; www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_spoergsmaal-og-svar-om-handicaptillaeg.md — Hvad gælder, hvis jeg havde arbejde inden mit studie?; Må jeg arbejde, mens I behandler min ansøgning?

custom.eventDescription:
If your impairment was diagnosed or treated in childhood, your most useful records may be old. Include the relevant medical history and the most recent records you have about the impairment.

The agency also needs to understand your functioning now. Existing records of support at school, a mentor, assistive devices or other support can add context. Your personal statement can explain your current situation and support needs.

A longstanding diagnosis does not by itself establish entitlement; the impact on your functioning and ability to work still matters.
custom.guide: SU-Handicap-report.md — Permanence; Severity and current functional level; www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_om-dokumentation.md — Minimumskrav til dokumentation; Anden dokumentation; Personlig redegørelse; www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_saadan-vurderer-vi-ansoegninger-om-handicaptillaeg.md — Art og grad

item.label: My records are old
Psychiatric or psychologist documentation
Both
Show the other topics

custom.eventDescription:
If your latest clinical records are more than three years old, attach them anyway. The documentation page recommends adding newer relevant material if you have it.

Older records help explain the history; newer material can describe your present functioning. You can also explain your situation in your personal statement. Do not pay for new documentation just to apply.
custom.guide: www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_om-dokumentation.md — Minimumskrav til dokumentation; Sådan skaffer du din dokumentation; Personlig redegørelse

custom.eventDescription:
Include records from psychiatric assessment and treatment, a treatment plan if available, and a discharge summary if treatment has ended. Relevant GP records can help if your GP now manages treatment.

If you were assessed only by a specialist psychologist, the guidance specifically asks for the detailed assessment report. A general psychologist statement is different and should be supplemented with medical documentation.

You may redact sensitive details that are not relevant, including information about other people. Keep the information needed to understand your impairment, treatment and work capacity readable; excessive redaction can leave the minimum requirements unmet.
custom.guide: www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_om-dokumentation.md — Psykiske funktionsnedsættelser; Sådan skaffer du din dokumentation; www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_om-dokumentation_eksempler-paa-dokumentation-paa-udvalgte-funktionsnedsaetteler.md — Dokumentation, hvis du har psykiske funktionsnedsættelser

custom.eventDescription:
Use your latest records to show what happened, the assessment and treatment since then, and the symptoms and difficulties you still have.

Permanence is assessed individually. Around a year of lasting symptoms can matter for conditions that are not inherently permanent; reaching a year does not automatically establish eligibility.

If treatment is ongoing and its outcome is uncertain, a time-limited supplement may be possible when the medical evidence indicates a likely lasting and significant impairment. Temporary illness or injury does not automatically qualify; extra SU clips for illness-related study delay are a separate possibility.
custom.guide: SU-Handicap-report.md — Permanence; Time-limited disability supplement; www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_saadan-vurderer-vi-ansoegninger-om-handicaptillaeg.md — Varighed; www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_om-dokumentation_eksempler-paa-dokumentation-paa-udvalgte-funktionsnedsaetteler.md — Hovedpine på grund af senfølger efter hovedtraume

item.label: Chronic headache or effects of a head injury
Chronic bowel disease
No thanks, show the other topics

custom.eventDescription:
Useful records explain the type, frequency, duration and severity of headaches, any accompanying symptoms, the treatment tried and its effect. Include relevant neurology or headache-clinic records; after treatment has ended, the examples page also describes relevant GP records from the last two years.

For lasting effects of a head injury, the guidance generally expects at least a year since the trauma, while retaining an individual assessment. Existing medical reports from an insurance case may also be useful.
custom.guide: www.su.dk_handicaptillaeg_om-dokumentation_eksempler-paa-dokumentation-paa-udvalgte-funktionsnedsaetteler.md — Dokumentation, hvis du lider af kronisk hovedpine; Hovedpine på grund af senfølger efter hovedtraume

custom.eventDescription:
The examples page asks for the latest records covering the last three years of treatment. They should describe the extent of your symptoms, your treatment, its effect and any side effects.

Hospital treatment records can be obtained from sundhed.dk. The effect on everyday functioning varies between people, so the diagnosis alone does not establish entitlement. You do not need to pay for new documentation just to apply.
